data.assumption: I interpreted “issuing banks did we see in the UK last month” as distinct non-null payment_attempts.issuing_bank values on all non-test payment attempts for UK showrooms during August 2026, using payment_attempts.business_date.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.issuing_bank) AS different_issuing_banks
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = FALSE
  AND o.is_test = FALSE
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND c.name = 'United Kingdom'
